mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.detail, c.name AS category, t.priority, t.due_date, t.completed, CASE WHEN t.completed = TRUE THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, COALESCE(s.subtask_count, 0) AS subtask_count, COALESCE(s.completed_subtask_count, 0) AS completed_subtask_count FROM todos t JOIN todo_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT todo_id, COUNT(*) AS subtask_count, SUM(CASE WHEN completed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_subtask_count FROM todo_subtasks GROUP BY todo_id ) s ON s.todo_id = t.id ORDER BY t.due_date, t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET status = #{status}, completed = (#{status} = 'COMPLETED') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.detail, c.name AS category, t.priority, t.due_date, t.completed, CASE WHEN t.completed = TRUE THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM todos t JOIN todo_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.detail, c.name AS category, t.priority, t.due_date, t.completed, CASE WHEN t.completed = TRUE THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM todos t JOIN todo_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, category_id, priority, due_date, completed, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, (SELECT id FROM todo_categories WHERE name = #{category}), #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{completed}, CASE WHEN #{completed} = TRUE THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'TODO' END)
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, category_id = (SELECT id FROM todo_categories WHERE name = #{category}), priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed = (#{status} = 'COMPLETED'), status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
